channel.title: Homeworld Press
channel.description: Independent editorial coverage of sci-fi literature, technology, space science, and tested buyer's guides.

item.title: Voyager 1 launched second and outran Voyager 2 to a light-day
item.description: Each trajectory was handed a different amount of speed before launch, depending on which planets it was pointed at.

item.title: Weight-Space Playgrounds Put Trained Parameters in a Tab
item.description: A new interactive demo invites readers to watch learning happen on their own hardware. Its lesson belongs to teaching, and its weakest word is programming.

item.title: NASA Pushes Mars Rotor Blades Past the Sound Barrier
item.description: A ground campaign takes helicopter blades into transonic flow on the one planet where a rotor has no margin left over

item.title: A Krill Fishery Works the Water Where Young Penguins Learn to Feed
item.description: The reported encounters fall in a bird's first year at sea, the stretch in which it acquires its feeding knowledge. That timing is what makes the finding hard to manage around, and the study's own figures were not available to this desk.

item.title: One tooth cannot carry a whole second hominin species
item.description: A report from southern China reads an unusual crown as company for Homo erectus. What the specimen can prove and what the headline implies are different claims.

item.title: A Supergiant's Sun-Like Companion Gives Webb a Phase to Measure
item.description: The announcement carries no distance, no orbit and no instrument. What it carries is the word confirms, and that word implies a prediction someone made first.

item.title: Bravia 8 II's Early Low Price Follows a Retail Calendar
item.description: A price floor set in mid-November is a scheduling decision by a brand and its chains, and the useful story is about which calendar Sony obeyed.

item.title: Reader Letters Arrive Under a Headline Nobody Signed
item.description: The Guardian's books desk ran correspondence on November 13 under a promise about the end of everything. The sentence at the top was the paper's, and that is what the format is for.

item.title: Cold Water Will Not Explain Where Glacial Carbon Hid
item.description: Ice-age CO2 lows are usually taught as a story about cold water soaking up more gas. A sealed surface is the stronger candidate, and the argument between them is a measurement problem.

item.title: Smaller Plankton Means More Mouths Between a Cell and a Fish
item.description: The new ocean result points at cell size, not cell count. Chlorophyll can stay flat while the energy reaching a fish collapses.
